description: Convert between price and yield for a Treasury bill, note or bond. Supply exactly one side — a price or a yield (a discount rate for a bill) — and the other is returned, with accrued interest, dirty price and the investment rate as applicable. For a note or bond, a CUSIP looks the terms up instead of restating them.

clean_price.description: Price per 100 of face, excluding accrued interest.

coupon_rate_percent.description: Annual coupon rate. Required for a coupon security without a CUSIP.

cusip.description: CUSIP of a note or bond; its terms are looked up.

discount_rate_percent.description: Bank discount rate for a bill.

frequency.description: Coupon payments per year. Defaults to 2.

instrument.description: "bill" for a discount instrument under a year, "coupon" for a note or bond. The maths differs; the wrong choice returns a plausible wrong number.

maturity_date.description: Maturity, YYYY-MM-DD. Required for a bill.

trade_date.description: Settlement date. Defaults to the most recent trading day.

yield_percent.description: Yield to maturity for a coupon security.

name: price_treasury_security
title: Price a Treasury security
